newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 29.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The People's Bank, the central bank, has set up two special phone lines for people to report irregularities on the financial markets.
- Selling of the latest batch of three-year treasury note being issued from May 1 to May 31 is slow mainly due to its lower coupon compared with high yields of listed state debt contracts.

- More than 20 people in the city of Tianjin have been admitted to hospital with heart and other ailments stemming from anxiety caused by sharp price fluctuations on the stock markets in recent days, indicating many new investors are not prepared for possible risks.
- BUSINESS NEWS - The Shanghai Metal Exchange has become the world's third largest base metal exchange after the London-based LME and New York-based COMEX since its establishment in 1992.
- Foreign investment in China's coastal provinces fell sharply in the first three months of this year.
